name: Porto Seguro S.A.
summary: Porto Seguro S.A., together with its subsidiaries, provides a range of insurance products and services in Brazil and Uruguay. It offers auto, residential, travel, cell phone, life, motorcycle, notebook and tablet, photo and video, smart and games, bike, real estate, green card, bail, and moving insurance products, as well as reinsurance, combined protection, professional civil liability, machines and equipment, events, agribusiness, and taxi insurance.
